analysis_label: R2.6 main25 exact-source AHE primary and predeclared host/Wol sensitivity
association_statement: User explicitly confirmed Wolbachia was extracted from the same sequencing files used for AHE; applied to frozen main25 with exact old-to-formal AHE alignment row continuity. This is author-provided source metadata, not independent machine specimen validation. USCO is separately labelled as historical exact-association sensitivity.
interpretation_rules: PACo and ParaFit use the same bijective host-label permutations as primary null.
PACo r0 is a declared sensitivity and may repeat Wol tips, not preserve both margins.
All inclusive-tail Monte Carlo p=(1+extreme)/(9999+1); package-style r0 p retained separately for legacy comparison.
USCO host comparison combines backbone and branch-length changes, not a pure topology-only experiment.
Expanded31 bacterial inferences are projected to main25 associations; no additional host identity is assumed.
Non-significance is lack of detected global congruence, not proof of transfer or absence of codivergence.
No per-link hypothesis testing or jackknife confidence claimed.
Bootstrap topology sensitivity and reconciliation/age scenarios remain separate required follow-up.
